title: Attention cues: optional sound, a brighter tab, and session and project tabs that blink together
story: A terminal that needs you can now play an optional beep, off until you turn it on in Settings > Notifications. A terminal waiting for input glows brighter red, and so does its chip in the parking tray. A terminal that comes back from the parking tray by itself makes its zoom-strip tab and its project tab blink yellow together, also after you switch between projects; before, the zoom tab was solid yellow and the project tab did not change. A warning flag set by hand still stays solid yellow.

checks.criterion: With the switch on, a sound plays once when a parked terminal comes back by itself and once when a terminal needs input; with it off, no sound plays.
checks.steps: Open Settings > Notifications and turn on 'Play a sound when a terminal needs you'. Launch a Claude terminal, ask it to 'wait 30 seconds, then ask me a yes/no question', park it and wait. Repeat with an unparked terminal. Turn the switch off and repeat both.
checks.expected: One short beep when the parked terminal comes back and one when the visible terminal starts waiting; no second beep for the same wait; no beep with the switch off.

checks.criterion: A session tab and its project tab blink in step, even when they start at different moments.
checks.steps: Open two projects. In project A launch two terminals and zoom into terminal 1. In terminal 2 ask a question that takes about 20 seconds, then park terminal 2. Switch to project B before the answer arrives. When terminal 2 comes back, watch project A's tab, then switch to A and compare it with terminal 2's zoom-strip tab. Switch to B and back to A once more.
checks.expected: Both tabs blink yellow at the same moment and rhythm, including after each switch back. Clicking terminal 2's tab stops both blinks.

checks.criterion: The glow on a terminal that needs input is visibly brighter than before.
checks.steps: Let an agent finish a turn so its terminal waits for input. Compare its frame with a working terminal next to it.
checks.expected: A bright red ring with a wide halo, clearly stronger than the working terminal's blue glow.
